content: Mobile VPN client feature research digest: typical mobile VPN client architecture is a thin client - Flutter UI + libbox/sing-box core + native VPN layer (Android VpnService foreground service, iOS NetworkExtension PacketTunnelProvider). Auth flows in native apps: email+password with min length validation, email confirmation codes, TOTP, or delegated web flows. Backend-driven server pools: client fetches servers list per pool (simple/whitelist) with protocol, flag, load, SNI allowlist; configs only with active key. Autoping via core urltest (HTTP generate_204), quick path by last-good servers, full pool ping; cache TTL 60s; network-change cache invalidation. Connect state machine idle->pinging->connecting->connected/disconnecting + error; cancel connecting; reconnect; core restart backoff. Subscription gating: no active key -> purchase; device limits (2-10) enforced server-side. Purchase: backend-driven tariffs, promo, Platega webhook; native apps face App Store IAP rules (StoreKit) vs external payments.
